projects.name: NetRaptor
projects.description: Modular, offensive-security-grade network intelligence and threat hunting platform built from the ground up. 12 integrated tools across 3 clusters -  recon, analysis, and response. The architecture is designed so every tool feeds every other tool: scanner output feeds the threat mapper, log analysis informs the SIEM simulator, incident response draws from everything.
projects.highlight: Architecture-first. No SaaS dependencies. One predator-instinct system.

projects.name: CTF Writeups & Practice Labs
projects.description: Ongoing documentation of CTF challenges and HackTheBox / TryHackMe rooms. Each writeup captures methodology, dead ends, tools used, and lessons learned. Dead ends are where the actual learning happens.
projects.highlight: Methodology over answers. How problems are approached matters more than whether I got it first.

projects.name: Academic Security Labs
projects.description: Three systems built across the Diploma in Systems Management & Cybersecurity. IoT PenTesting Device (MQTT scanning, Hydra brute-force, Nmap discovery, sensor targeting). Train Control System at Resurgo Place, Moncton -  4 Raspberry Pi nodes, joystick control, heavy-duty motors, live public display. Full Network Overhaul -  3 routers, 2 switches, EtherChannel, VLAN segmentation, routing and redundancy.
projects.highlight: Graduated with Honors · GPA 3.9 -  every lab backed by graded assessments and documented reports.

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Built from scratch. Boot sequence with dehashing animation, animated globe background, interactive academic node graph, NetRaptor ecosystem pie-chart system, full card layout. Zero dependencies, zero frameworks.
projects.highlight: Zero dependencies. The architecture is the portfolio.
